company_name: Jiangsu ESTURD Packaging Group Co., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides specialized packaging solutions for cleanroom environments, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Jiangsu ESTURD Packaging Group Co., LTD. manufactures cleanroom containers and packaging solutions for the semiconductor and fine chemical industries. Their products include advanced packaging containers for wet electronic chemicals and photoresists, utilizing high-quality HDPE materials and automated production lines to ensure compliance with environmental standards.
